description: This file defines a static class 'HostingGrainExtensions' with an extension method 'AddGrainExtension' for configuring grain extensions on an Orleans silo. It facilitates registration of grain extension implementations with dependency injection.

classes.name: HostingGrainExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring grain extensions on an Orleans silo.

methods.name: AddGrainExtension
methods.description: Registers a grain extension implementation for a specified interface on the ISiloBuilder, enabling dependency injection of grain extensions.
